summary: Extracts the upper 15 bits of the bitfield dword at this+0x2C by shifting right 17, converts the remaining unsigned value to double, and scales it by 0.1 (1/10). Returns the scaled double. Called per-frame from vehicle physics timestep, vector-to-short conversion and audio cross-fade paths; the skeleton fill treats it as the inverse of a float-to-bitfield pack.

local_names.this: object holding the packed bitfield dword at offset 0x2C

operations.description: Read the bitfield dword at this+0x2C and extract bits 17-31 by shifting right 17, yielding a 15-bit unsigned value
Convert the extracted value to double and scale it by 0.1, the read-only float constant backed by a module global
Return the scaled double; no guard conditions, reads directly. Called from VectorToShort3Conversion, VehiclePhysicsTimeStep and AudioSampleCrossFadeInterpolation

unresolved: The purpose of the packed 15-bit value (its source field and what the 0.1 scale maps back from) is not documented in this function's own evidence; the skeleton fill's inverse-of-pack claim is external prose, not packet evidence
